task.description:
Start all required backend services and restore the app listener for the ISS-0063 regression run.

1. Bring up the backend runtime stack and any missing services needed by the app.
2. Wait until all required services are healthy.
3. Verify GET http://localhost:8081/health/ready and psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c "SELECT 1".
4. Run zig build migrate to apply any pending migrations.
5. Restore the app so http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/ready responds again.

Return PASS only when the app and backend services are healthy and migration completes successfully.

result.summary: Restored the backend runtime stack, confirmed the app listener on 127.0.0.1:8080 is responding, verified Keycloak and the test database are healthy, and applied migrations with no pending changes.
